name: JS-MA-Day
summary: A Moving Average-based Expert Advisor designed for daily timeframe trading, following trend direction identified by MA crossovers or price-MA relationships. The EA systematically enters positions when trend conditions align on the daily chart and manages trades with trend-following exit logic.
summary_zh: 基于移动均线的日内趋势跟踪EA，通过均线交叉或价格与均线关系判断趋势方向。EA在日线图上趋势条件满足时系统性地建仓，并使用趋势跟踪逻辑管理持仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA策略基于移动均线(MA)在日线级别的趋势跟踪，核心概念是利用均线方向判断中长期趋势并顺势交易。入场条件推测为价格突破均线或短期均线上穿长期均线时做多，反之做空。出场条件可能采用均线反向交叉或价格跌破均线时平仓，也可能结合追踪止损保护利润。仓位管理方面，日线级别EA通常使用固定手数或基于ATR的波动率仓位计算。资金管理上，作为趋势跟踪系统，盈亏比通常较大但胜率较低，依赖少数大趋势覆盖多次小亏损。该策略适合趋势明确的市场环境，在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a Moving Average-based trend following strategy on the daily timeframe, with the core concept of using MA direction to identify medium-to-long-term trends and trading in alignment. Entry conditions likely involve price breaking above the MA or a short-period MA crossing above a long-period MA for longs, with the reverse for shorts. Exit conditions may use reverse MA crossovers or price breaching the MA on the opposite side, potentially combined with trailing stops to protect profits. Position sizing is typically fixed lot or ATR-based volatility sizing for daily timeframe EAs. Money management follows the trend-following paradigm of large reward-to-risk ratios but lower win rates, relying on occasional large trends to cover multiple small losses. The strategy performs well in trending markets but may generate frequent false signals in ranging conditions, leading to consecutive small losses.

parameters.name: MA_Method
parameters.description: 均线计算方法(简单/指数/加权)

pros: 日线级别交易，避开短期市场噪音，信号更可靠
趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，盈亏比通常较高
均线策略参数少，易于理解和优化
日线周期交易频率低，减少交易成本和滑点影响
适合长期资金管理，不需频繁盯盘
pros_en: Daily timeframe trading avoids short-term market noise, producing more reliable signals
Trend following strategy has clear logic and typically favorable risk-reward ratios
MA strategy has few parameters, making it easy to understand and optimize
Low trading frequency on daily charts reduces transaction costs and slippage impact
Suitable for long-term capital management without requiring constant monitoring
cons: 均线滞后性严重，入场和出场信号延迟明显
震荡行情中频繁产生虚假信号，导致连续亏损
日线级别止损空间大，单笔亏损金额较高
缺乏市场状态识别机制，趋势和震荡市使用同一逻辑
单一均线策略过于简单，无法适应复杂市场变化
cons_en: Significant MA lag causes delayed entry and exit signals
Frequent false signals in ranging markets lead to consecutive losses
Large stop loss distance on daily timeframe means higher absolute loss per trade
Lacks market regime identification, applying same logic in both trending and ranging conditions
Single MA strategy is overly simplistic and cannot adapt to complex market dynamics
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，如H4趋势方向与日线一致才入场
引入市场状态过滤器(如ADX或波动率指标)，震荡市暂停交易
加入ATR动态止损止盈，替代固定点数止损以适应不同波动环境
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., only enter when H4 trend aligns with daily direction
Introduce market regime filter (e.g., ADX or volatility indicator) to pause trading in ranging markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit instead of fixed pip values to adapt to varying volatility

risk_points: 日线止损空间大，单笔亏损可能占总资金比例较高
缺乏震荡市过滤，可能在区间震荡中连续亏损
均线滞后可能导致趋势反转时回吐大量浮盈
risk_points_en: Large daily stop loss distance may result in significant single-trade loss relative to total capital
Lacks ranging market filter, risking consecutive losses in sideways conditions
MA lag may cause substantial floating profit giveback when trends reverse

summary_en: A Moving Average-based Expert Advisor designed for daily timeframe trading, following trend direction identified by MA crossovers or price-MA relationships. The EA systematically enters positions when trend conditions align on the daily chart and manages trades with trend-following exit logic.
